name: 林間弓手
prompt: Design ONE full-body game enemy: Mature-faced semi-chibi humanoid, 4.5 heads tall forest archer, dark green leather armor, deep hood concealing face, stern narrow eyes, longbow in LEFT hand and arrow drawn RIGHT, back quiver, asymmetric leaf cape. Detailed Japanese manga dark fantasy JRPG monster illustration, fine variable-weight ink lines, cel-shaded shadows plus subtle gradients and highlights, consistent upper-left light. Slightly stylized semi-chibi proportions: humanoids about 4.5 to 5 heads tall, mature faces, slightly larger head and hands, compact limbs; creatures have heads about 12% larger than natural with compact expressive silhouette. NOT tiny 2.5-head chibi, not baby-like, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Threatening three-quarter front view facing RIGHT, compact readable silhouette and generous 15% empty margin. Reference image is STYLE ONLY; DO NOT COPY its pumpkin, body, clothing or equipment. Follow the new creature description exactly.
